related.description: ⚡️⚡️⚡️ Self-hosted collaborative bookmark manager to collect, read, annotate, and fully preserve what matters, all in one place.
Free open-source bookmark manager with customisable nested tags. Super fast and lightweight. All data is stored locally.
Self-hosted bookmark manager that is designed be to be minimal, fast, and easy to set up using Docker.
The personal, minimalist, super-fast, database free, bookmarking service - community repo
